steps.title: Classification
steps.layout_strategy: Use a segmented control or horizontal chips for product_type (rental/sale/digital). Category can be a chip grid or dropdown. Tags should be an input with horizontal scrollable chips below. Maximize vertical space by avoiding cards.

steps.title: L'essentiel
steps.layout_strategy: Title as a large, prominent TextInput. Brand/Model as standard TextInput. Condition as a 2x2 grid of touchable chips (neuf/très bon/bon/acceptable) to eliminate scroll.

steps.title: Détails
steps.layout_strategy: Three stacked inputs. Limit the height of 'long_description' to 3-4 lines initially (expandable if needed, but optimally stays within view) to prevent pushing content down.

steps.title: Médias
steps.layout_strategy: 3x2 grid of square photo upload slots. The first slot must be distinct (e.g., border highlight or 'Principale' badge). Clean and evenly spaced.

steps.title: Tarification
steps.layout_strategy: To avoid clutter, show 5 pill-toggles for the formats (heure/jour/semaine/mois/séance). When a format is activated, animate in its specific price input below. SpotYou section only appears if 'séance' is active.

steps.title: Logistique
steps.layout_strategy: Row of 2 large touchable cards for handover mode. Inline inputs for duration and deposit that appear only conditionally to keep the initial view completely uncluttered.

steps.title: Règles
steps.layout_strategy: 3 textareas. Keep borders minimalistic (#21262D) and use subtle background (#161B22) to avoid a heavy, boxed-in look. Label them clearly with '(Optionnel)'.

steps.title: Localisation
steps.layout_strategy: Map component takes the top 35-40% of the screen. City input and availability note follow below. No scrolling required if proportions are managed.

steps.title: Récapitulatif
steps.layout_strategy: Large quality score circle/badge at the top. A dense but readable summary list. Fixed bottom container for primary action buttons.

component_strategies.TextInput: Background #161B22, border #21262D (1px), placeholder #8B949E, text #E6EDF3, borderRadius 12. Focus state: border #3B82F6. Include data-testid.
component_strategies.Chip: Background #161B22, text #8B949E, borderRadius 999. Active state: Background #3B82F6, text #FFFFFF. Include data-testid.
component_strategies.Card: Background #161B22, borderRadius 12, border #21262D. Flat design, no elevation shadows. Include data-testid.
component_strategies.Header: Compact layout. Left: Back button. Center: 'Étape X/9'. Right: Quality score mini-badge. Bottom border: #21262D.
component_strategies.Navigation: Fixed bottom safe area view. Single 'Suivant' button (blue pill, full width, height 56px, bold text) to ensure consistent layout.

ux_recommendations.avoid_scroll: Strictly limit each step to a maximum of 3-4 fields. Use progressive disclosure (conditional rendering) for fields like pricing inputs, duration, and deposits.
ux_recommendations.visual_hierarchy: Required fields should have standard labels. Optional fields must have an inline '(Optionnel)' muted span. Remove heavy info cards; replace with inline 12px muted text hints directly below inputs.
ux_recommendations.interactions: Use smooth opacity/layout animations when conditional fields appear to avoid jarring jumps.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the ProductCreationFlow stepper in React Native (Expo) by expanding it from 6 to 9 steps to completely eliminate scrolling within steps. Implement the layout strategies detailed in the 'architecture' section. Use React Native primitive components (View, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Switch) and apply the exact hex colors from the 'colors' object via StyleSheet. Pay special attention to 'Step 5: Tarification'—do not display all 5 price inputs at once; use toggles to reveal them. Ensure every interactive element has a clear 'data-testid' for testing.
